data.action: 托腮看着蛋糕两眼放光
data.description: 【艾雅法拉 · 宿舍茶点】温馨可爱的宿舍小圆桌前，艾雅法拉双手托腮，看着面前刚出炉的草莓奶油小蛋糕两眼放光，羊角在头顶欢快地晃动——「哇！前辈特意为我带了蛋糕吗？因为听力不太好，平时总让前辈费心大声说话……真的太谢谢前辈了！」
data.promptProse: At the dormitory’s small round table, Eyjafjalla cups both cheeks and gazes delightedly at the strawberry cream cake. Preserve the cream-and-tan sheep pajamas and fleece hood. Two cups of tea steam beside the plate in the medium close-up. The table’s curved near edge frames the cake, while the chair back separates her from a narrow bookshelf beside the room’s window. Bright afternoon daylight reveals the frosting ridges and her happy eyes. The cups cast soft separate shadows onto the tabletop, and steam catches a pale highlight without hiding the cake; the bookshelf’s recessed compartments remain subdued.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 宿舍茶点
